name: Data Collection Plan
description: Creates data collection plans with instrument selection, participant criteria, ethical considerations, and timeline for learners designing research studies. Produces a complete data collection protocol. Use when a learner asks to plan data collection, design a survey or interview protocol, determine sample size, or address research ethics requirements. Do NOT use for choosing a methodology (use `research-methodology`), for analyzing collected data (not an education skill), or for writing the methods section (use writing category skills).
